channel.title: Sound baths in Boulder · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Boulder, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Wednesday Meditation
item.description: Unity of Boulder's weekly Wednesday evening gathering includes group meditation with a rotating sound bath of live crystal and Tibetan singing bowls, native flute, and chanting. Where: Unity of Boulder Spiritual Center, Boulder. Price: Free (donation appreciated). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/wednesday-meditation-2026-08-26-unity-of-boulder-spiritual-center/

item.title: Full Moon Healing Cloud of Sound Meditation Concert with Sarina Shrestha
item.description: A full moon sound meditation concert with Himalayan singing bowls and gongs led by Sarina Shrestha at Atma Buti in Boulder, benefiting a Nepal orphanage nonprofit. Where: Atma Buti Sound and Vibrational School, Boulder. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/full-moon-healing-cloud-of-sound-meditation-concert-with-sarina-shrestha-2026-08-27-atma-buti-sound-and-vibrational-school/
